I · The package

Three days in the Eternal City

Fly out of London on Friday and spend the evening in Trastevere's lantern-lit lanes. Saturday is the Colosseum and the Trevi Fountain. On Sunday you walk out of Rome and into another country, Vatican City, before flying home.

II · The itinerary

Day by day

Three days, each built around one of Rome's great sights.

I

Friday 27 November

Arrive in Rome · Trastevere by night

Fly from London to Rome, take the train into the city and check in. Then the evening is spent in Trastevere: cobbled lanes, ivy-covered walls and some of the liveliest streets in Rome after dark.

II

Saturday 28 November

The Colosseum tour · Trevi Fountain

Step inside the Colosseum and stand in the arena where gladiators fought nearly two thousand years ago. Then on to the Trevi Fountain. Throw a coin over your shoulder and, so the legend goes, you'll be back in Rome one day.

III

Sunday 29 November

Walk to a whole country · Vatican City

Vatican City is the smallest country in the world, and you can walk into it. We cross from Rome into St Peter's Square, then take the train back to the airport and fly home.

VIII · Good to know

Before you book

Who can come

This trip is for men only, aged 18 or over on the date of travel.

Passports

Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the trip, so until at least 29 May 2027. On a non-UK passport? Check whether you need a visa for Italy before you book.

At the border

The EU's Entry/Exit System is now in use, so if it's your first trip to Europe since it started you'll have your fingerprints and photo taken at passport control. Allow a little extra time.

Weather

Late November in Rome is cool and mild, around 14°C by day and 6°C at night, with a chance of rain. It's dark by about 4:45pm. Bring a warm jacket and comfortable shoes.

Cancellations

Payments are non-refundable and bookings can't be cancelled, unless a replacement is found to take your place.
